svg.title: Hotel service priorities · Check the language model before ranking services
svg.desc: Proposed extension · not performed. Develop annotation, uncertainty and transfer checks around the existing PRCA analysis. Proposed workflow. No new data or model results are claimed.

g.text: Check the language model before ranking services

g.title: Label a stratified review subset. Audit attribute mapping and polarity separately, including mixed-sentiment and ambiguous sentences.
Compare the current mapping with a multilingual encoder or supervised classifier. Reuse the same labelled evaluation split; do not choose a model from attractive examples.
Assess whether findings survive alternative sentiment thresholds and dependence within properties. Compare property-clustered uncertainty with the reported HC1 specification.
Reserve later reviews and new properties. Examine whether priority rankings remain stable before linking the analysis to service investment.
